<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';

$plugins = array(
	'gutenberg/gutenberg.php',
	'handbook/handbook.php',
	'wporg-markdown/plugin.php',
	'code-syntax-block/index.php',
	'posts-to-posts/posts-to-posts.php',
	'wordpress-importer/wordpress-importer.php',
	'jetpack/jetpack.php',
);

foreach ( $plugins as $plugin ) {
	if ( file_exists( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . $plugin ) && ! is_plugin_active( $plugin ) ) {
		activate_plugin( $plugin, '', false, true );
	}
}

switch_theme( 'wporg-developer-2023' );

$pages = array(
	'home' => array(
		'post_title' => 'Home',
		'post_name' => 'home',
	),
	'reference' => array(
		'post_title' => 'Reference',
		'post_name' => 'reference',
	),
	'resource' => array(
		'post_title' => 'Resource',
		'post_name' => 'resource',
	),
);

$page_ids = array();
foreach ( $pages as $key => $page ) {
	$existing = get_page_by_path( $page['post_name'] );
	if ( $existing ) {
		$page_ids[ $key ] = $existing->ID;
		continue;
	}

	$page_ids[ $key ] = wp_insert_post( array(
		'post_type' => 'page',
		'post_title' => $page['post_title'],
		'post_status' => 'publish',
		'post_name' => $page['post_name'],
	) );
}

if ( empty( get_page_by_path( 'resource/dashicons' ) ) ) {
	wp_insert_post( array(
		'post_type' => 'page',
		'post_title' => 'Dashicons',
		'post_status' => 'publish',
		'post_name' => 'dashicons',
		'post_parent' => isset( $page_ids['resource'] ) ? $page_ids['resource'] : 0,
	) );
}

if ( ! empty( $page_ids['home'] ) ) {
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_ids['home'] );
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
}

update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%year%/%monthnum%/%postname%/' );
flush_rewrite_rules();
